data.controls: Candidate REJECT for omitted u; control ACCEPT with u declared. Exact type Sort(succ u) and value Sort u shared. Raw importer prints must match both cases before trust0 replay. Nanoda candidate must reach all_uparams_defined assertion in tc.rs:554, not generic failure. After this start, execute the exact target lka.py loader/discovery and create_test static-file path in detached local checkout. Validate its own schema and verify output stats/name/reject/sha256 and copied NDJSON against frozen candidate bytes. Feed produced bytes to checkers only after that equality gate. Current official Arena config is Lean4.34.1. Its current Nanoda config pins e0d76f5, unlike this retained 3a24072 binary; no claim to have run that newer build or the whole Arena checker matrix. Current Nanoda wrapper normalizes any nonzero/non-decline failure to rejection; preserve raw101 and verify its semantic assertion before calling this observed rejection.
